title: Robot Sowing Cosmic Garden
description: A vibrant blue robot covered in colorful patterns stands at the center, pouring a pile of dark soil or compost from its hand. Red-and-white spotted mushrooms grow around it while a green parrot with a red head perches on its shoulder holding ginkgo leaves. The scene is framed by a border of multicolored polka dots against a dark, surreal forest background with ghostly hooded figures.
prompt: A blue robot adorned with bright geometric patterns stands in a surreal landscape, pouring dark soil from its hand as red and white fly agaric mushrooms grow around its feet. A green parrot with a red head and ginkgo leaves perches on the robot's shoulder. Dark ghostly hooded figures stand in the background forest. The entire scene is framed by a dense border of overlapping colorful polka dots in rainbow hues, whimsical psychedelic style, detailed digital painting.
